categories.main_business_segments: Zhuhai Aerospace Microchips Science & Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three segments: aerospace electronics (including embedded SoC chips, SiP modules, and aerospace electronic systems), satellite constellation and satellite big data services (including remote sensing micro-nano satellite constellation and related data products and services), and artificial intelligence (AI) chips, modules, algorithms, and intelligent security and traffic systems. The company also engages in geographic information and intelligent surveying and mapping services through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced aerospace electronics technologies such as embedded SoC chips, SiP modules, and aerospace bus communication modules. It develops AI chips (Yulong series) with capabilities in target recognition and image processing, and invests in satellite on-orbit intelligent processing systems. Production involves in-house manufacturing combined with outsourced wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing. The company also integrates AI algorithms for satellite data processing and intelligent surveying, employing advanced packaging and heterogeneous integration technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include aerospace and aviation sectors requiring high-reliability core components, government agencies and enterprises utilizing satellite remote sensing data for applications in agriculture, forestry, water resources, environmental protection, and urban planning. The AI and intelligent security segments serve public security, judicial, municipal, transportation, and smart city markets. The company’s satellite data services target government units, industry enterprises, and consumer markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with headquarters and major facilities in Zhuhai and subsidiaries across Guangdong, Beijing, Shanghai, Qingdao, Gansu, and other provinces. It also has overseas subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Macau. Its satellite constellation provides global coverage with rapid revisit capabilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhuhai Aerospace Microchips operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the aerospace and satellite data supply chain. It designs and manufactures core aerospace electronic components and modules, operates satellite constellations, processes satellite data, and provides integrated data services and AI solutions. It also offers system integration and software services, positioning itself as a comprehensive provider from component manufacturing to end-user applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in next-generation aerospace SoC chips, AI chips with enhanced computing power, and heterogeneous integration packaging technologies. It focuses on developing satellite on-orbit intelligent processing platforms to improve data timeliness and expand application scenarios. Strategic emphasis is placed on domestic substitution of imported components, advancing AI algorithms for satellite data analysis, and expanding intelligent surveying and smart city solutions. The company also aims to deepen integration of aerospace, AI, and big data technologies to build a leading commercial aerospace ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of aerospace electronic components (SoC chips, SiP modules, EMBC systems), satellite data products and services (including customized remote sensing data and applications), AI chips and algorithm licensing, and integrated intelligent security and traffic system solutions. The company mainly uses a direct sales model, including project bidding and customized product development, with some recurring service revenues from data operations and maintenance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhuhai Aerospace Microchips is a leading domestic player in aerospace electronics and commercial satellite data services, recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and a key contributor to China's aerospace and AI chip industries. It holds a competitive position in high-reliability aerospace components and is among the few Chinese companies operating commercial remote sensing satellite constellations. The company faces competition from other aerospace electronics manufacturers, AI chip developers, and satellite data service providers but leverages strong government and institutional partnerships to maintain its industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 212 million, a decline of nearly 40% from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 294 million, showing improvement compared to prior years. Total assets stood at approximately RMB 2.47 billion. The company has experienced revenue and profit volatility due to industry challenges and investment in satellite constellation projects but continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures exceeding 50% of revenue, indicating a focus on long-term growth and technology leadership.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced aerospace electronics technology, including domestically developed high-reliability SoC and SiP products, and its pioneering satellite constellation with high spectral resolution capabilities. Its integration of AI algorithms for satellite data processing and intelligent surveying solutions provides differentiated, high-value services tailored to government and industry needs. The company’s ability to offer end-to-end aerospace electronic components, satellite data acquisition, processing, and application services, combined with strong national strategic alignment and proprietary technology, constitutes its core competitive advantage.
